title: Sync credential short-circuit and pullstream sugar bridge
author: Ava Morgan
release_notes: Introduce a lightweight credential short-circuit provider to reduce streaming reconnect latency; add PullStream.Builder ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; bump SDK versions (py 1.30.0, ts 2.18.0, go 1.9.3); minor telemetry key added (auth.latency_ms).
description: Motivation: Streaming callers observed spikes in auth latency during reconnects where cached tokens were valid but code path performed a full refresh/handshake. This PR introduces a 'short-circuit' credential provider that returns a cached token when its TTL is sufficient for the outgoing request and otherwise falls through to the existing refresh flow. In parallel, we add a compact PullStream.Builder (py/ts/go) to standardize common streaming patterns (timeout, batchHint, backpressureHint, credentialProvider) and reduce per-call plumbing. Summary of changes includes: new credential short-circuit implementation, unified PullStream.Builder API and examples, test coverage for race conditions during concurrent reconnects, light telemetry for auth latency, and coordinated SDK version bumps. Commits: - add short-circuit credential provider and tests (avoid unnecessary refresh) - introduce PullStream.Builder facade and examples for py/ts/go - wire auth.latency_ms metric and update telemetry proto mapping - fix TS lint errors found by CI and add docstrings - bump sdk versions and changelogs Changed areas/files (high level): - sdk/python/redwood/credentials/shortcircuit.py (new) - sdk/typescript/src/stream/pullstream/builder.ts (new) - sdk/go/pullstream/builder.go (new) - sdk/*/examples/pullstream_builder_demo.* (new examples) - sdk/python/tests/test_shortcircuit_race.py (new tests) - telemetry/schema/auth_metrics.proto (minor addition) - docs/sdk/pullstream_builder.md (docs) - package.json / setup.cfg version bumps Review summary: Initial review flagged a race where two concurrent reconnect handlers could both attempt a refresh despite the short-circuit; I added a lock-free test that reproduces the original race and then a fix using an atomic compare-and-swap on the cached token window. Security reviewed the short-circuit logic to ensure no stale tokens are returned past safety window; added explicit TTL jitter and a note in docs about conservative defaults. TS CI initially failed on lint and a missing export from the builder interface; author fixed the export and added list of examples. Performance tests (microbench) show approx 12-18% median tail latency reduction on reconnect-heavy workloads in internal lab. CI: initial run failed (ts-lint) -> developer pushed fix -> re-ran -> all checks green. Merge: squash merge to main; merge commit: a3f9d7c6b2e8f4a1d6c9e2b4f0c8a7b5d3e2f1c4
